title: What is missing
description: The system boots, logs in and installs packages. It is not something to run on real hardware yet. This is the list of why.
hast:
The system boots, logs in and installs packages. It is not something to run
on real hardware yet.

It has never booted on real hardware. The kernel
config (

) was written for QEMU's machine: virtio
devices, and virtio-gpu, bochs and simpledrm for the display.
The kernel limine boots is a copy.

It is copied into the FAT partition
when the image is built.

on the
root, not that copy: the FAT partition is mounted at

, but the
linux package does not install there, and palm has no hooks to copy it.
No su or passwd for palm.

busybox is not setuid, so palm cannot become
root. Members of wheel install and remove packages through Software and
palmd; anything else (

) is done as
root on the serial console.
glibc, libxkbcommon and xkeyboard-config come from the build host
The window manager on bare metal

has no VT switching (Ctrl+Alt+Fn does
nothing, the console is not put into graphics mode), enumerates input
devices once at startup so hotplugged keyboards and mice are ignored, has
only ever run one monitor, and repaints the whole screen on the CPU every
frame. Clients see keys as press and release pairs, so none can see a key
held down.

22 of the 47 programs work on the bare system, 9 partly,
16 not at all: those need ffmpeg, PipeWire, NetworkManager, BlueZ, ollama,
pacman or OpenSSL (
app is not packaged, and busybox's
applet is left out because the names clash.
has the gaps listed in the root

. The main ones: an installed disk boots only through UEFI,
and part of the interface stays in English.
No swap until the kernel has zram.
palm-init sets up zram swap from
yet, so it says so at boot and runs without swap. Disk swap in

works. Growing the root on first boot handles only a GPT disk
whose last partition is an ext4

's resolver backtracks but is not a SAT solver (a step budget stops
a pathological search); its TLS client checks no revocation; indexes do not
expire (only an older one is refused); each package is still decompressed
whole in memory to install.

keeps no utmp, wtmp or lastlog, ignores shadow's aging fields,
and limits guessing only by a 1.5 s delay per failed attempt.

seen in the verification screenshots: a single left
click in term leaves a one-cell selection, and the greeter's Shut Down
button shows no hover state.
